entries.text: "I won't let the flame of this\nvaliant battle festival die!"
"I'm the last Warwing!\nI'll use all my power!"
"You seem to want death!\nThen I'll grant it!"
"Tch! Rookies in battle are a pain!"
"I won't let you have your way!"
"Answer my call! Time to end all!"
"Very well... time to show\nyou a Senshi's battle."
"Such an attack would never hit me!"
"Heh heh heh... Fight\ntill your Element's gone!"
"Blood boils...! This\nis the thrill of war!"
"Tch! I'd toy with you,\nbut changed my mind!"
"...Heh, Reika's recklessness...\nI look forward to it..."
"Thanks... for putting\nup with my bad luck!"
"Jun, make sure you defeat the enemy!"
"Rena, I'll take care of the rest!"
"Nice move, Glen! I won't fall behind!"
"When we get back, it's\nspecial training, Jun!"
"An arrow of the heart\nmight reach, but me...!"
"I had a bad feeling,\nbut it was nothing...!"
"Stop, Sirius! Don't hurt\nanyone with your hands!"
"Sirius...! What I did\ncan't be forgiven. But...!"
"Main core's still fine...!\nThere's still a chance!"
"Th-this is the gap between\nhuman and Fallen Angel...!?"
"This time I won't let go, Sirius!"
"Asakim Dowen! You bring\nmisfortune to the world!"
"Edel! I won't let your selfishness\nmake the world suffer!"
"The source of the world's misery...\nI'll put an end to it myself!"
"Continuous fire on the enemy\nahead! Don't let them escape!"
"Coordinators and all\nwho aid them are foes!"
"Enemy in range! Don't let them go!"
"This is no damage. Ignore small fry!"
"Don't slow the ship!\nWe'll be picked off!"
"Damn! Keep taking hits and it's over!"
"Not yet! We must not sink yet!"
"At this rate, we must fall back...!"
"He won't land a hit! Strike now!"
"Don't falter! They're monsters.\nWe must annihilate them!"
"Ngh! We must down that or lose all!"
"Damn it! Strike them or we die!"
"As I thought, we must root them\nout starting with the PLANTs...!"
"Not yet! Until I smash\nevery cursed hourglass!"
"How many times will he\nstand in our way...!"
"No more chaos on this\nbattlefield! Bring it down!"
"How many times must he block us?!"
"We have justice on our side.\nNo mercy for Coordinators!"
"A-at this rate, we may have no\nchoice but to fall back...!?"
"You failed to shoot your target\ndown! Your luck's run out!"
"Are you saying you've read our range!?"
"You don't grasp the gap in power!"
"Even a battleship's\nattack is how you take it!"
"We can fight evenly with a Gundam!"
"Whoa! Not yet, until the ship falls!"
"Gah! What do I do!? What do I do!"
"Kira Yamato, you side against us too!"
"A Gundam can fall if fought right!"
"Gah! But if he won't land a hit...!"
"Tch, you really mean\nto stop this war...!"
"Damn! I lost track of my ammo!"
"Not yet! We can't sink! Not\ntill we run out of ammo!!"
"No good! Just a sitting duck like this!"
"Guh! A hit or two is nothing to me!"
"N-not yet! I have\nnot bowed to you yet!"
